description: This is a PHP class named RestoreDatabaseToSavepointController located in the Controller namespace, which handles HTTP requests to restore a database to a specific savepoint during functional testing in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling HTTP requests to restore the database to a specified savepoint during testing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to restore the database state to a savepoint and returns the response with the count of tables restored.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the restore request, retrieves the savepoint name from the request, triggers the restore operation, and returns a JSON response with the count of tables restored.
